definitions.explanation: A situation in which the amount of a product available for sale falls short of demand. Used of individual items on store shelves as well as of a whole market.

examples.japanese: ⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{品不足|しなぶそく}だ。
⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{品不足|しなぶそく}になった。
examples.english: Vegetables ran short because of the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{品不足|しなぶそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧おり、⟦{新車|しんしゃ}→新車：11334_shinsha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{納車|のうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{半年待|はんとしま}ちだそうだ。
examples.english: The parts shortage is continuing, and delivery of a new car reportedly takes six months.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {品不足|しなぶそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to run short
- {品不足|しなぶそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: for a shortage to continue
- {品不足|しなぶそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}される→解消する：21324_kaishousuru⟧: for a shortage to be resolved
- ⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧な{品不足|しなぶそく}: a serious shortage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{品切|しなぎ}れ→品切れ：09557_shinagire⟧: sold out — the stock of one item at one shop is gone
- ⟦{在庫切|ざいこぎ}れ→在庫切れ：08305_zaikogire⟧: out of stock — focuses on the inventory itself
- ⟦{供給不足|きょうきゅうぶそく}→供給不足：30658_kyoukyuubusoku⟧: supply shortage — more technical, used of markets and industries
